description: Company-level compliance posture: per-framework posture from the daily cloud scans (checks passed/failed, controls tested/failing), plus threat and control metrics from code scans. Pass `framework` (e.g. 'ISO 27001') to get that framework's most-failing controls. Rates are percentages (0-100).

framework.description: Optional framework name or id, e.g. 'ISO 27001', 'NIST'

name: compliance_status
title: Get Compliance Status
